Equipment & Hardware (The Big "Things")
Espresso Machine: The core engine for coffee.

Grinder: For grinding coffee beans fresh.

POS (Point of Sale): The register system.

Pitcher Rinser: A sink attachment to instantly clean and cool milk pitchers.

Auto-Tamper (e.g., Puqpress): A machine that tamps the coffee puck mechanically for perfect consistency.

Kitchen Display System (KDS): A digital screen to replace paper tickets for orders.

Smart Scales: Digital scales to weigh espresso shots as they pull.

High-Speed Oven (e.g., TurboChef): An oven that toasts/warms food in seconds rather than minutes.

Smallwares & Setup Items
Milk Pitchers: For steaming milk.

Tongs: For handling bakery items hygienically.

Wax Paper: For serving pastries.

Warming Bags: For holding warmed items.

Cups, Lids, Sleeves: The essential serving vessels.

"The Pass": A designated physical counter space for finished orders only.
